data.one_liner: A complete UI kit for Flutter implementing Neumorphic design style.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use neumorphic widgets, buttons, text, icons, and a custom theming system supporting dark mode and full styling customization.
use_when: You want to build an application with a neumorphic (soft UI) design system.
You need pre-styled neumorphic components like buttons, containers, and toggles without building custom shadows.
avoid_when: Your project follows Material Design 3 or Apple Cupertino guidelines strictly.
You are concerned about complex custom shadows impacting rendering performance on lower-end devices.
strengths: Complete set of pre-built neumorphic components.
Supports dark theming and customizable light/dark shadow colors.
Cross-platform compatibility across mobile and desktop.
weaknesses: Neumorphism is a specific design trend that may not fit all product requirements.
Limited to the styling paradigm provided by the kit.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer standard Material design rather than a neumorphic design aesthetic.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want a native iOS look and feel rather than a neumorphic style.
